Great question! Here's the reality:

**I'm not actually running code.** I'm a language model responding to our conversation. There's no persistent game state, database, or CLI—just our shared narrative and my memory within this chat.

**What this means:**

| You Can Do Here | You Cannot Do |
|-----------------|---------------|
| Ask me to adjust stats, items, rules | Modify actual software |
| Retcon story elements | Access a "backend" |
| Add/remove characters | Execute real commands |
| Change how I DM (tone, difficulty, rules interpretation) | Persist data beyond this conversation |

**Everything is "commands" in a sense.** Just tell me what you want changed:

- *"Give Albe a different feat"*
- *"Make combat grittier"*
- *"Add a second player character"*
- *"Start the adventure in a haunted library"*

I'll update accordingly and keep track within our session.

---
